verdict.rationale: Pulley is a cap table and equity-management SaaS (cap tables, SAFEs, 409A valuations, compliance), not an AI agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client. Its term sheet scanner is a narrow AI feature, not an agent that calls external tools. Nothing in the evidence shows Pulley consuming MCP servers, so plugging MCP servers into it is a wrong-axis question for this kind of product.
